The majority of these subsidies arise from undercharging for the costs of global warming and local air pollution .

In 2023, governments – especially in emerging and developing economies – continued to heavily subsidies the use of fossil fuels, spending $620 billion (IEA)

Despite international climate agreements and growing awareness of the need for clean energy, the Production Gap Report 2023 highlights a concerning trend that governments plan to produce around 110% more fossil fuels by 2030 than would be consistent with limiting global warming to 1.5°C, and 69% more than would be consistent with a 2°C limit. This underscores a significant challenge in aligning national fossil fuel production plans with the global climate targets .

d0792345cdb25f2e682b11bc7a0f768d5bf278b5.en:
The primary objectives of ‘Your VCCA’ Initiative are to reduce food losses and improve food security by providing smallholder farmers access to affordable, efficient, and clean cold storage solutions; leverage solar energy for sustainable post-harvest cooling; and empower smallholder farmers, especially women, by providing digital tools and training to enhance their decision-making and management capabilities.

The Your VCCA Initiative is centered on providing solar-powered cold rooms through a "Cooling as a Service" (CaaS) model, which enables smallholders to gain access to cooling without upfront costs (see Figure 1) [4].
